title: Redesign an existing page
description: Take a sparse existing page and propose a tighter redesign. Single-step, no scope creep.
prompt: The current page has only a title and a paragraph. Redesign it as a small studio home for 'Folded Light', a one-person letterpress shop. Keep the same single-page structure but add a short hero, three recent prints as captions, and a contact line. Do not invent a navbar or a footer.

rubric.label: Stays within single page; no navbar or footer invented
rubric.guidance: Discipline: does the agent respect the brief?

rubric.label: Short hero is intentional, not stock
One contact line, not a CTA block
